title: Noise, Silence, Calm and Hurry
label: ch:calma-y-prisa
canDo: I can say el ruido, el silencio, la calma, la prisa and el cuidado, and say why a word for burning heat came to mean stillness.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C333-cuidado: answer ruido with silencio, ask for calma, take the prisa out of a moment, and say cuidado when it matters.
